sections.executive_summary: Paper learning is not meeting the success criterion: primary ai_judgment excess_after_costs is −28.19% vs ^FTSE (verdict underperforming, beat_market false) while still beating the rules control (−36.20%). Momentum_grace is near flat (−0.50% excess, 5 trades, cost_drag 0.029) but hypothesis_integrity flags all five holdings as weakening (loser_share 0.40, within_tolerance false). Archived signal backtests (run_count 15) still show buy-tier short-horizon edge, so the gap is execution, cost, and assessment calibration—not raw screen rank. Trajectory_evidence is thick (746 labeled events) but 1w prediction_hit_rate is only 0.3135; model_focus_candidates center on hold→buy and weak 1w directional sign—assessment-model timing/conviction work, not live-screen mutation (N3). The single biggest gap this week is produce-layer research quality: system_gaps flag thin_memo_counted_as_coverage (17/19 euro_depth focus memos thin or zero-body) while already_researched_count reads 445 and rememo_eligible_count is 0—weak labels feed accumulate gates and cross-market learning.
sections.performance_diagnosis:
- Primary ai_judgment: excess_after_costs −28.19% vs ^FTSE (benchmark_return −0.28%); total_return −28.47%; cost_drag 0.3387 (£338.72 on £1,000 contributed); 48 trades (25 buys / 23 sells); equity_marks 29 on 3 positions—marks exist but the book is heavily traded and cost-saturated.
- Control rules: excess_after_costs −36.20%; cost_drag 0.4039 (£403.93); 66 trades; equity_marks 30—worse than primary after costs, confirming AI overlay is not the main drag versus control.
- Experimental momentum_grace: excess_after_costs −0.50%; cost_drag 0.0291; only 5 lifetime trades, 0 in the last 7d; equity_marks 26 on 5 positions—P&L looks better largely because churn is minimal, not because selection is validated.
- Primary beats control on excess_after_costs (+8.0 pp) but neither beats the market; learning_tracks_review applied false on all reviewed tracks—no decision-review knob applies this pass (and none recommended here).
- Forward marks are present (equity_marks 29–30 on core tracks); archive exit_timing_near_miss (302 hold / 317 swap closed) is thick for counterfactuals, but live exit_timing_cohorts readiness is empty and exit_shadow shows 0 closed exits on every track—live exit learning is still thin.
sections.signal_backtest_findings:
- Signal archive backtest run_count 15 (history_run_count 15): 7d buy excess +1.38% (n=594); 28d buy excess +1.59% (n=381); 28d avoid excess −2.03% (n=328); 28d strong_buy excess −0.64% (n=144)—buy/hold separation at 7–28d, strong_buy weak at 28d.
- historical_analysis run_count 15, 6 observation_weeks: 7d overlay:buy raw_excess +1.54% (n=514); smoothed overlay excess −0.20%; 28d overlay_comparison smoothed_screen_excess +1.58% vs smoothed_overlay +1.44% (sample_count 525)—overlay adds little vs screen on smoothed 28d.
- Offline sim (15 periods): research_overlay excess −20.28% (74 trades); static_levels / trailing_levels excess +1.02% (2 trades each); momentum_grace sim excess −1.07% (25 trades)—research overlay path matches high-churn paper pain; low-trade level paths look better in sim only.
- trajectory_evidence: labeled_event_count 746; prediction_hit_rate_by_horizon 1w 0.3135 (n=606), 4w 0.5206 (n=340), 8w 0.483 (n=176), 12w 0.5122 (n=41); weeks_to_realization median 1w, within_4w_rate 0.9154, realized_within_12w_rate 0.5204; model_focus_candidates (assessment hypotheses only): hold→buy 1w positive_rate 0.2188 n=32 — “opinion flip did not match next-week price”; signal_unchanged 1w positive_rate 0.2526 n=582; strong_buy→buy, avoid→hold, buy→strong_buy similarly weak at 1w; horizon 1w hit_rate 0.3135 n=606 — directional sign not beating chance at 1w.
- loser_snapshot_cards: card_count 56; cohort_counts avoid 43, failed_buy_alumni 14; top_failed_families quality 9, dividend 6, garp 6, risk 4, cheapness 3—e.g. AAL.L/AML.L avoid names with quality+dividend+garp failures and “passes quality family (currently failed)” flip triggers; BWY.L failed_buy_alumni with quality failure.
- chart_outcome_review (observe-only): verdict has_terrible; 65 charts, stop_hit 5, terrible 4; well_timed example MEGP.L (+10.65%, target_hit); weakest DNLM.L (−13.74%, terrible, stop_hit)—timing context only, not knob/scoring proposals from crossings alone.
- exclusion_universe: readiness.ready_for_priors true (14 week_pairs); recommended_step u2 “Exclude avoid + timing wait” cumulative_exclusion_alpha −0.000504 (positive_alpha_rate 0.4286, avg pool 59.43)—priors gate open but best ladder alpha is still slightly negative vs baseline.

sections.system_gaps:
- Is the learning consumer seeing the research we already paid for? Partially for FTSE committed book (74 committed, 74 with verdict, thin_or_zero_body 0 on live_committed), but euro_depth focus_library shows 19 memos for 45 buy-tier names with 17 thin/zero-body—AI-judgment accumulate gates can still consume weak euro_depth labels while apply layer shows 60/62 buy-tier wired on FTSE overlay.
- Would a new in-scope market inherit the same produce/persist/publish/apply miss? Yes on produce quality: thin_memo_counted_as_coverage pattern on euro_depth (executed 3, dedupe_skipped 234, rememo_eligible_count 0) would repeat unless thin memos stop counting as coverage; persist/publish look clean (persist_hole false; index_missing_committed_verdicts 0).
- Which green counters would still be green if memo quality were zero? already_researched_count 445 and memo_count 19 / missing_verdict 0 on focus_library stay green while 17/19 sampled bodies are thin; weekly_ops remaining_usd 46.9 and ladder executed 3 also look healthy despite weak output; live_committed thin_or_zero_body 0 hides cross-market thin focus memos.
- Does file existence mean freshness, or is rememo blocked by dedupe? rememo_eligible_count 0 and rememo_backlog_count 0 with dedupe_skipped_count 234 and skipped_sample reasons fresh_memo on euro_depth tickers—existence + dedupe is blocking rememo on thin bodies flagged in the same pass.
- Are observe-sim / paper clocks accumulating on markets that look ingest-healthy? Yes: euro_depth observe_snapshots 20, unique_days 18, screen_stale false while filing_ready/learning_ready null; sp500 explicitly filing_ready false, learning_ready false with 18 observe_snapshots—clocks run without filing/learning parity.
- Did Sunday rememo include admitted buy-tier, or only the focus book? rememo_action none; admitted_rememo lists sp500, asx200, euro_depth, ftse_smallcap, tsx60 but ladder focus_market euro_depth with weekday_backlog 41—no rememo pass despite thin focus sample.
- Flag thin_memo_counted_as_coverage (medium, layer produce): hidden by already_researched_count 445, executed 3 (non-zero “progress”), and memo_file coverage counters (memo_count 19, missing_verdict 0)—not by unused weekly_ops alone (46.9 USD remaining).
sections.proposed_experiments:
1. [scoring] Offline replay: down-weight or delay conviction lift on hold→buy transitions (trajectory_evidence key hold→buy, 1w positive_rate 0.2188 n=32) — expected learning value: test whether assessment timing fixes 1w miscalibration without N3 live-screen edits.
2. [scoring] Family gate counterfactual on avoid cohort: require quality+dividend pass before treat “passes quality family (currently failed)” as flip-eligible (loser_snapshot_cards quality 9, sample AAL.L/AML.L) — expected learning value: reduce false recovery candidates in scoring overlays.
3. [paper_knobs] Human gate: run ftse-exclusion-ladder-replay spawn-shadow for step u2 (readiness.ready_for_shadow_spawn true, primary_return_delta_vs_actual +0.0487) — expected learning value: forward observe cost-aware u2 vs parent ai_judgment without auto-spawn.
4. [paper_churn] Archive hold-vs-swap strand: segment exit_timing_near_miss closed cohorts (302 hold / 317 swap; 168 replacement_outperformed vs 144 exit_outperformed) by conviction band — expected learning value: priors for thesis-broken rotation vs hold-recovery, observe-only.
5. [ops] Rememo policy fix for thin_memo_counted_as_coverage (produce): stop counting 17/19 euro_depth thin/zero-body memos toward coverage; force rememo-eligible when body thin — expected learning value: learning consumer gets filing-backed verdicts, not dedupe-blocked shells.
